<![CDATA[import type { Metadata, Viewport } from "next";
import { Familjen_Grotesk, Hanken_Grotesk, IBM_Plex_Mono } from "next/font/google";
import "./patchbay/patchbay.css";

const display = Familjen_Grotesk({ subsets: ["latin"], weight: ["500", "600", "700"], variable: "--font-familjen", display: "swap" });
const body = Hanken_Grotesk({ subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-hanken", display: "swap" });
const mono = IBM_Plex_Mono({ subsets: ["latin"], weight: ["400", "500"], variable: "--font-plex-mono", display: "swap" });

const DESCRIPTION = "A developer portfolio that re-routes itself. Plug into Web, Full-stack, AI or UX/UI and the whole page re-composes around that discipline.";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Patchbay: one portfolio, four disciplines",
  description: DESCRIPTION,
  openGraph: { title: "Patchbay: one portfolio, four disciplines", description: DESCRIPTION, type: "website" },
  twitter: { card: "summary_large_image" },
};

export const viewport: Viewport = { width: "device-width", initialScale: 1, themeColor: "#15161A" };

export default function PatchbayLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`${display.variable} ${body.variable} ${mono.variable}`}>
      <body className="pby-body">
        <noscript>
          <style>{`[data-reveal],.pby-line-inner{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;clip-path:none!important}`}</style>
        </noscript>
        {children}
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(patchbay)/patchbay/assets.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";

const BASE = "/templates/patchbay";

export function assetSrc(key: string, width: 800 | 1600, format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp"): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

type PictureProps = { assetKey: string; alt: string; className?: string; sizes?: string; priority?: boolean };

export function Picture({ assetKey, alt, className, sizes = "(min-width: 900px) 50vw, 100vw", priority }: PictureProps) {
  const webp800 = assetSrc(assetKey, 800);
  if (!webp800) {
    return (
      <div className={`pby-placeholder ${className ?? ""}`} role="img" aria-label={alt} data-asset={assetKey}>
        <span className="pby-mono">{assetKey}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const { w, h } = ASSETS[assetKey];
  const set = (format: "webp" | "avif") => `${assetSrc(assetKey, 800, format)} 800w, ${assetSrc(assetKey, 1600, format)} 1600w`;
  return (
    <picture className={className}>
      <source type="image/avif" srcSet={set("avif")} sizes={sizes} />
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- processed AVIF/WebP set with explicit dimensions */}
      <img src={webp800} srcSet={set("webp")} sizes={sizes} width={w} height={h} alt={alt} loading={priority ? "eager" : "lazy"} fetchPriority={priority ? "high" : undefined} decoding="async" data-asset={assetKey} />
    </picture>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { ImageResponse } from "next/og";

export const alt = "Patchbay: one portfolio, four disciplines";
export const size = { width: 1200, height: 630 };
export const contentType = "image/png";

const ROLES = ["WEB", "FULL-STACK", "AI", "UX/UI"];

export default function OpengraphImage() {
  return new ImageResponse(
    (
      <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", justifyContent: "space-between", width: "100%", height: "100%", background: "#15161A", color: "#ECE8DF", padding: 72 }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 6, color: "#9A9CA3" }}>PATCHBAY · DEVELOPER PORTFOLIO</div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", fontSize: 104, lineHeight: 1.02, fontWeight: 700 }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex" }}>One engineer from</div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", color: "#F2A93B" }}>schema to pixel.</div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 16 }}>
          {ROLES.map((role, index) => (
            <div
              key={role}
              style={{
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 12,
                padding: "14px 22px",
                border: "2px solid #34373D",
                background: index === 1 ? "#F2A93B" : "#1E2024",
                color: index === 1 ? "#15161A" : "#ECE8DF",
                fontSize: 26,
              }}
            >
              {role}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    ),
    size,
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { RoleProvider } from "./bay/RoleProvider";
import { ScrollProgress } from "./motion/ScrollProgress";

import { Process } from "./sections/Process";
import { Stack } from "./sections/Stack";

export default function PatchbayPage() {

    <RoleProvider>
      <ScrollProgress />

        <Hero />
        <Work />
        <Stack />
        <Process />

      </main>
      <Footer />

}

<![CDATA[@import "tailwindcss";

@theme {
  --color-ink: #15161A; /* page */
  --color-panel: #1E2024; /* cards, bay, case-study slab */
  --color-seam: #34373D; /* hairlines, empty jack holes */
  --color-bone: #ECE8DF; /* text */
  --color-steel: #9A9CA3; /* muted text, labels */
  --color-amber: #F2A93B; /* the only signal accent */

  --font-display: var(--font-familjen), "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-hanken), system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-plex-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;

  /* technical / cinematic: scrubbed, exact, no wobble except the plug seating */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1);
  --ease-spring: linear(0, 0.35 8%, 0.82 20%, 1.06 30%, 1.02 42%, 0.99 58%, 1);

  --dur-instant: 90ms;
  --dur-fast: 180ms;
  --dur-base: 420ms;
  --dur-slow: 800ms;
  --dur-hero: 1200ms;

  --reveal-shift: 28px;
  --stagger: 70ms;
}

/* ---------- base ---------- */
.pby-body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--color-ink);
  color: var(--color-bone);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  overflow-x: clip;
}
html {
  scroll-padding-top: 72px;
  background: var(--color-ink);
  overflow-x: clip;
}
.pby-shell {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px);
}
.pby-sr {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.pby-mono {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.pby-tabular {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.pby-amber {
  color: var(--color-amber);
}
:where(.pby-body) :focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
.pby-link {
  color: var(--color-bone);
  text-decoration: none;
  background: linear-gradient(var(--color-amber), var(--color-amber)) 0 100% / 100% 1px no-repeat;
  padding-bottom: 2px;
}

/* ---------- type ---------- */
.pby-h1,
.pby-h2,
.pby-h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin: 0;
}
.pby-h1 {
  font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 7.2vw, 6.25rem);
  line-height: 1.02;
  min-height: 2.12em; /* two lines reserved, so swapping roles never shifts the page */
}
.pby-h2 {
  font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 4vw, 3.25rem);
  line-height: 1.08;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.pby-h3 {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.pby-line {
  display: block;
  overflow: clip;
  padding-bottom: 0.12em;
  margin-bottom: -0.12em;
}
.pby-line-inner {
  display: block;
}
.pby-eyebrow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  color: var(--color-steel);
  margin: 0 0 20px;
}
.pby-eyebrow-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-amber);
}
.pby-sub,
.pby-lede {
  color: var(--color-steel);
  max-width: 58ch;
  margin: 24px 0 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.6vw, 1.25rem);
}

/* ---------- buttons ---------- */
.pby-magnetic {
  display: inline-block;
  transform: translate(var(--mag-x, 0), var(--mag-y, 0));
}
.pby-btn {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 15px 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-bone);
  font: 600 0.98rem var(--font-body);
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-spring), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-btn::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background: var(--color-amber);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out-expo);
}
.pby-btn-primary {
  background: var(--color-amber);
  color: var(--color-ink);
  border-color: var(--color-amber);
}
.pby-btn-primary::before {
  background: var(--color-bone);
}
.pby-btn-arrow {
  display: inline-block;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.97);
  transition-duration: var(--dur-instant);
}
.pby-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.7;
  cursor: progress;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .pby-btn:hover:not(:disabled)::before {
    transform: scaleX(1);
  }
  .pby-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) {
    color: var(--color-ink);
    border-color: var(--color-amber);
  }
  .pby-btn:hover .pby-btn-arrow {
    transform: translateX(5px);
  }
}
.pby-cta-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 32px;
}
.pby-spinner {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-ink);
  border-top-color: transparent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: block;
}

/* ---------- header ---------- */
.pby-header {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0 0 auto 0;
  z-index: 50;
}
.pby-header::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 82%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-header[data-state="compact"]::before,
.pby-header[data-menu="open"]::before {
  opacity: 1;
}
.pby-header-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  height: 64px;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px);
}
.pby-logo {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.pby-logo-mark {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  flex: none;
}
.pby-logo-name {
  font: 600 1.02rem var(--font-display);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
.pby-header-logo {
  color: var(--color-bone);
  text-decoration: none;
  transform-origin: left center;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-header[data-state="compact"] .pby-header-logo {
  transform: scale(0.92);
}
.pby-nav {
  position: relative;
  display: none;
  gap: 4px;
}
.pby-nav-link {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  color: var(--color-steel);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-nav-link[aria-current="true"],
.pby-nav-link:hover {
  color: var(--color-bone);
}
.pby-nav-indicator {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 1px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--color-amber);
  transform-origin: left;
  transform: translateX(var(--ind-x, 0px)) scaleX(var(--ind-w, 0));
  opacity: var(--ind-o, 0);
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out-expo), opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-chips {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 4px;
}
.pby-chip {
  padding: 7px 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-steel);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-spring);
}
.pby-chip[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--color-amber);
  border-color: var(--color-amber);
  color: var(--color-ink);
}
.pby-chip:active {
  transform: scale(0.95);
  transition-duration: var(--dur-instant);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .pby-chip:hover:not([aria-pressed="true"]) {
    color: var(--color-bone);
    border-color: var(--color-steel);
  }
}
.pby-chips-header {
  display: none;
}
.pby-menu-toggle {
  position: relative;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.pby-menu-bars,
.pby-menu-bars::before {
  position: absolute;
  left: 12px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--color-bone);
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out-expo);
}
.pby-menu-bars {
  top: 16px;
}
.pby-menu-bars::before {
  content: "";
  left: 0;
  top: 8px;
}
.pby-header[data-menu="open"] .pby-menu-bars {
  transform: translateY(4px) rotate(45deg);
}
.pby-header[data-menu="open"] .pby-menu-bars::before {
  transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(-90deg);
}
.pby-menu {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 32px;
  padding: 96px clamp(20px, 6vw, 48px) 40px;
  background: var(--color-ink);
  clip-path: circle(0 at calc(100% - 42px) 32px);
  transition: clip-path var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-in-out);
}
.pby-menu[data-open="true"] {
  clip-path: circle(150vmax at calc(100% - 42px) 32px);
}
.pby-menu nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.pby-menu-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 12px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  color: var(--color-bone);
  font: 600 clamp(1.8rem, 8vw, 2.6rem) var(--font-display);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.pby-menu-link .pby-mono {
  color: var(--color-amber);
}
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .pby-nav,
  .pby-chips-header {
    display: flex;
  }
  .pby-menu-toggle,
  .pby-menu {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* ---------- progress + pulse ---------- */
.pby-progress {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 60;
  width: 100%;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--color-amber);
  transform: scaleX(var(--progress, 0));
  transform-origin: left;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.pby-pulse {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0 0 auto 0;
  z-index: 55;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--color-amber) 30%, var(--color-amber) 70%, transparent);
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.pby-hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 100svh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  padding-top: 112px;
  overflow: clip;
}
.pby-grid-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-bone) 6%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-bone) 6%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 64px 64px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 40%, black, transparent);
}
.pby-hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 56px;
}
.pby-metrics {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 40px 0 0;
  max-width: 760px;
}
@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .pby-metrics {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
  }
}
.pby-metric dt {
  color: var(--color-steel);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.pby-metric dd {
  margin: 0;
  font: 600 clamp(1.7rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem) var(--font-display);
}
.pby-hero-ticker {
  border-block: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  background: var(--color-ink);
  position: relative;
}
.pby-marquee {
  overflow: hidden;
}
.pby-marquee-track {
  display: flex;
  width: max-content;
}
.pby-marquee-set {
  display: flex;
  flex: none;
}
.pby-tick {
  padding: 14px 28px;
  color: var(--color-steel);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.pby-tick::after {
  content: "/";
  margin-left: 56px;
  color: var(--color-amber);
}

/* ---------- patch bay ---------- */
.pby-bay-wrap {
  margin-top: 44px;
  max-width: 760px;
}
.pby-bay-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  color: var(--color-steel);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.pby-led-row {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.pby-led {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-amber);
}
.pby-bay {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--color-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  border-radius: 2px;
  --plug-y: 84px;
}
.pby-bay::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 22px;
  top: 16px;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--color-seam);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--color-amber) 0 3px, transparent 3.5px);
}
.pby-bay-in {
  position: absolute;
  left: 48px;
  top: 16px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: var(--color-steel);
}
.pby-cable {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  overflow: visible;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.pby-cable path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--color-amber);
  stroke-width: 3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}
.pby-plug {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  margin: -13px 0 0 -13px;
  border: 3px solid var(--color-amber);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-ink);
  transform: translate(var(--plug-x, 0px), var(--plug-y));
  pointer-events: none;
}
.pby-plug::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -3px;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-amber);
  border-radius: 50%;
  opacity: 0;
}
.pby-bay[data-ready="false"] .pby-cable,
.pby-bay[data-ready="false"] .pby-plug {
  opacity: 0;
}
.pby-jacks {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
}
.pby-jack {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 0 4px 14px;
  border: 0;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-bone);
  font: 600 0.98rem var(--font-body);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-jack:first-child {
  border-left: 0;
}
.pby-jack-hole {
  position: absolute;
  top: 72px;
  left: 50%;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  margin-left: -12px;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-seam);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-ink);
  transition: border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-jack-code {
  color: var(--color-steel);
  font-size: 0.64rem;
}
.pby-jack[data-active="true"] .pby-jack-hole {
  border-color: var(--color-amber);
}
.pby-jack[data-active="true"] .pby-jack-code {
  color: var(--color-amber);
}
.pby-jack:active .pby-jack-hole {
  transform: scale(0.9);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .pby-jack:hover {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-bone) 4%, transparent);
  }
  .pby-jack:hover:not([data-active="true"]) .pby-jack-hole {
    border-color: var(--color-steel);
  }
}

/* ---------- sections ---------- */
.pby-section {
  padding-block: clamp(80px, 12vw, 160px);
}
.pby-section-head {
  max-width: 760px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px);
}
.pby-section-head .pby-lede {
  margin-top: 20px;
}

/* work */
.pby-cards {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
@media (min-width: 640px) {
  .pby-cards {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
@media (min-width: 1000px) {
  .pby-cards {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
.pby-card-slot {
  display: flex;
}
.pby-card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--color-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  border-radius: 2px;
  transform: perspective(900px) rotateX(var(--rx, 0deg)) rotateY(var(--ry, 0deg)) translateY(var(--lift, 0px));
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(360px circle at var(--mx, 50%) var(--my, 0%), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 16%, transparent), transparent 60%);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-card-media {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.pby-card-media img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  transition: transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-placeholder {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-ink) 0 10px, var(--color-panel) 10px 20px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  color: var(--color-steel);
}
.pby-card-body {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 22px;
}
.pby-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  color: var(--color-steel);
  margin: 0;
}
.pby-card-kind {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-amber);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}
.pby-card-blurb {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  color: var(--color-steel);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
}
.pby-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.pby-tag {
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  color: var(--color-steel);
}
.pby-card-proof {
  margin: auto 0 0;
  padding-top: 14px;
  font: 600 1.05rem var(--font-display);
}
.pby-fit {
  height: 3px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  background: var(--color-seam);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.pby-fit-bar {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--color-amber);
  transform: scaleX(var(--fit, 0));
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out-expo) 300ms;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .pby-card:hover {
    --lift: -6px;
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 55%, var(--color-seam));
  }
  .pby-card:hover::after {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  .pby-card:hover .pby-card-media img {
    transform: scale(1.06);
  }
  .pby-cards:has(.pby-card:hover) .pby-card:not(:hover) {
    opacity: 0.6;
  }
}

/* stack / signal flow */
.pby-flow {
  display: grid;
  gap: 28px;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
@media (min-width: 860px) {
  .pby-flow {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 96px;
  }
}
.pby-flow-col {
  position: relative;
}
.pby-flow-title {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  color: var(--color-steel);
}
.pby-flow-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.pby-flow-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  background: var(--color-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  border-radius: 2px;
}
[data-col="core"] .pby-flow-item {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 45%, var(--color-seam));
}
.pby-flow-port {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  flex: none;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-amber);
  border-radius: 50%;
}
.pby-flow-wire {
  display: none;
}
@media (min-width: 860px) {
  .pby-flow-wire {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: -96px;
    display: block;
    width: 96px;
    height: 2px;
  }
  .pby-flow-wire-line {
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--color-amber);
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
  .pby-flow-pulse {
    position: absolute;
    top: -3px;
    left: 0;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--color-amber);
  }
}

/* process */
.pby-steps {
  display: grid;
  gap: 32px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
@media (min-width: 640px) {
  .pby-steps {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
@media (min-width: 1000px) {
  .pby-steps {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
.pby-step-rule {
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--color-amber);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.pby-step-num {
  color: var(--color-amber);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.pby-step-body {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  color: var(--color-steel);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
}

/* case study */
.pby-case {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: clamp(80px, 12vw, 160px);
  border-block: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  isolation: isolate;
}
.pby-case::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background: var(--color-panel);
  transform-origin: top;
}
.pby-case-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 40px;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .pby-case-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 64px;
    align-items: start;
  }
}
.pby-case-media-wrap {
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
}
.pby-case-media {
  display: block;
}
.pby-case-media.pby-placeholder {
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.pby-case-copy {
  display: grid;
  gap: 28px;
}
.pby-case-label {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  color: var(--color-amber);
}
.pby-case-problem {
  margin: 0;
  font: 500 1.35rem/1.35 var(--font-display);
}
.pby-case-list {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 1.1em;
  color: var(--color-steel);
}
.pby-case-list li + li {
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.pby-case-results {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 0;
}
.pby-case-result {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column-reverse;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  background: var(--color-ink);
}
.pby-case-result dd {
  margin: 0;
  font: 600 clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.2rem) var(--font-display);
  color: var(--color-amber);
}
.pby-case-result dt {
  color: var(--color-steel);
}

/* about */
.pby-about {
  display: grid;
  gap: 40px;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .pby-about {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 64px;
  }
  .pby-about .pby-section-head,
  .pby-about .pby-timeline {
    grid-column: 2;
  }
  .pby-about .pby-section-head {
    grid-row: 1;
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }
  .pby-about-copy {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1 / span 2;
  }
  .pby-about .pby-timeline {
    grid-row: 2;
  }
}
.pby-about-copy .pby-lede:first-child {
  margin-top: 0;
}
.pby-timeline {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
}
.pby-timeline-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 80px 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 16px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
}
.pby-timeline-year {
  color: var(--color-amber);
  padding-top: 4px;
}

/* contact */
.pby-contact {
  display: grid;
  gap: 40px;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .pby-contact {
    grid-template-columns: 5fr 7fr;
    gap: 64px;
  }
  .pby-contact .pby-section-head {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }
}
.pby-form-stage {
  display: grid;
}
.pby-form-stage > * {
  grid-area: 1 / 1;
}
.pby-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  align-content: start;
}
@media (min-width: 640px) {
  .pby-form {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
  .pby-form .pby-field-wide {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
}
.pby-field {
  position: relative;
}
.pby-field input,
.pby-field select,
.pby-field textarea {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 26px 14px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--color-panel);
  color: var(--color-bone);
  font: 1rem var(--font-body);
  appearance: none;
  transition: border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-field textarea {
  resize: vertical;
  min-height: 140px;
}
.pby-field label {
  position: absolute;
  left: 15px;
  top: 17px;
  color: var(--color-steel);
  font-size: 1rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform-origin: left top;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
}
.pby-field input:focus ~ label,
.pby-field input:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ label,
.pby-field textarea:focus ~ label,
.pby-field textarea:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ label,
.pby-field select ~ label {
  transform: translateY(-11px) scale(0.78);
}
.pby-field::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--color-amber);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out-expo);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.pby-field:focus-within::after {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}
.pby-field input:focus,
.pby-field select:focus,
.pby-field textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
}
.pby-field[data-invalid="true"] input,
.pby-field[data-invalid="true"] select,
.pby-field[data-invalid="true"] textarea {
  border-color: var(--color-amber);
}
.pby-field-select::before {
  content: "▾";
  position: absolute;
  right: 14px;
  top: 22px;
  color: var(--color-steel);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.pby-count {
  position: absolute;
  right: 12px;
  bottom: 10px;
  color: var(--color-steel);
}
.pby-error {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  color: var(--color-amber);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}
.pby-error::before {
  content: "↳ ";
}
.pby-form[aria-busy="true"] .pby-field {
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.pby-success {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 32px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-amber);
  background: var(--color-panel);
  border-radius: 2px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.pby-form-stage[data-status="success"] .pby-success {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}
.pby-form-stage[data-status="success"] .pby-form {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.pby-check {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
}
.pby-check circle,
.pby-check path {
  stroke: var(--color-amber);
  stroke-width: 2.5;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}
.pby-success-ref {
  color: var(--color-steel);
  margin: 8px 0 0;
}
.pby-success .pby-lede {
  margin-top: 4px;
}

/* footer */
.pby-footer {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-seam);
  padding-block: 40px;
}
.pby-footer-inner {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
}
.pby-footer-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-steel);
}
.pby-footer-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: 24px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.pby-footer-note {
  flex-basis: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-steel);
}

/* ---------- motion (no-preference only: hidden pre-reveal states live here, so no-JS and reduced-motion users see everything) ---------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  @keyframes pby-in {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(16px);
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-line-rise {
    from {
      transform: translateY(110%);
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-settle {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(1.06);
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-swap-in {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(10px);
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-sweep {
    0% {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    12% {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    100% {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(100vh);
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-latch {
    0% {
      opacity: 0.9;
      transform: scale(0.8);
    }
    100% {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(2);
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-blink {
    50% {
      opacity: 0.25;
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-marquee {
    to {
      transform: translateX(-50%);
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-travel {
    from {
      transform: translateX(0);
      opacity: 0;
    }
    20%,
    80% {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    to {
      transform: translateX(88px);
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-spin {
    to {
      transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-drop {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(-6px);
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-draw {
    from {
      stroke-dashoffset: 140;
    }
  }
  @keyframes pby-success-rise {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(14px);
    }
  }

  .pby-load {
    animation: pby-in var(--dur-hero) var(--ease-out-expo) both;
    animation-delay: var(--d, 0ms);
  }
  .pby-grid-bg {
    animation: pby-settle var(--dur-hero) var(--ease-out-expo) both;
  }
  .pby-line-inner {
    animation: pby-line-rise var(--dur-hero) var(--ease-out-expo) both;
    animation-delay: calc(250ms + var(--i, 0) * 90ms);
  }
  .pby-swap {
    animation: pby-swap-in var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out) both;
  }
  /* After the first route the page is already loaded: replays start immediately. */
  html[data-routed] .pby-line-inner {
    animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 70ms);
    animation-duration: var(--dur-slow);
  }
  html[data-routed] .pby-load {
    animation-name: pby-swap-in;
    animation-delay: 0ms;
    animation-duration: var(--dur-base);
  }

  .pby-pulse {
    animation: pby-sweep 900ms var(--ease-in-out) both;
  }
  .pby-plug {
    transition: none;
  }
  .pby-plug[data-seated="true"]::before {
    animation: pby-latch 520ms var(--ease-out) both;
  }
  .pby-led {
    animation: pby-blink 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .pby-marquee-track {
    animation: pby-marquee 48s linear infinite;
  }
  .pby-marquee:hover .pby-marquee-track,
  .pby-marquee:focus-within .pby-marquee-track {
    animation-play-state: paused;
  }
  .pby-flow-pulse {
    animation: pby-travel 2.6s linear infinite;
  }
  .pby-spinner {
    animation: pby-spin 700ms linear infinite;
  }
  .pby-error {
    animation: pby-drop var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out) both;
  }
  .pby-check circle,
  .pby-check path {
    stroke-dasharray: 140;
    animation: pby-draw 700ms var(--ease-out-expo) 120ms both;
  }
  .pby-success > * {
    animation: pby-success-rise var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out-expo) both;
  }
  .pby-success > :nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: 120ms;
  }
  .pby-success > :nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: 200ms;
  }
  .pby-success > :nth-child(4) {
    animation-delay: 280ms;
  }
  .pby-success > :nth-child(5) {
    animation-delay: 360ms;
  }
  .pby-form-stage .pby-form,
  .pby-form-stage .pby-success {
    transition: opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out-expo);
  }
  .pby-form-stage[data-status="success"] .pby-form {
    transform: translateY(-12px);
  }

  /* handoff: the hero lifts and dims as the work slab slides in */
  .pby-hero-inner {
    transform: translateY(calc(var(--hero-p, 0) * -48px)) scale(calc(1 - var(--hero-p, 0) * 0.04));
    opacity: calc(1 - var(--hero-p, 0) * 0.55);
    transform-origin: 50% 0;
  }
  .pby-grid-bg {
    transform: translateY(calc(var(--hero-p, 0) * 40px));
  }

  .pby-menu-link {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(24px);
    transition: opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out-expo);
  }
  .pby-menu[data-open="true"] .pby-menu-link {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    transition-delay: calc(240ms + var(--i, 0) * 60ms);
  }

  [data-reveal] {
    transition: opacity var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out), clip-path var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-in-out);
    transition-delay: calc(var(--delay, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--stagger));
  }
  [data-reveal="rise"]:not([data-in="true"]) {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(var(--reveal-shift));
  }
  [data-reveal="scale"]:not([data-in="true"]) {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(32px) scale(0.96);
  }
  [data-reveal="wipe"]:not([data-in="true"]) {
    clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0);
  }
  [data-reveal="draw"]:not([data-in="true"]) {
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left;
  }
  [data-reveal="draw"] {
    transform-origin: left;
  }
  [data-reveal="slide-left"]:not([data-in="true"]) {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-24px);
  }
  [data-reveal="slide-right"]:not([data-in="true"]) {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(24px);
  }
  [data-reveal="wipe"] .pby-placeholder,
  [data-reveal="wipe"] img {
    transition: transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out);
  }
  [data-reveal="wipe"]:not([data-in="true"]) .pby-placeholder,
  [data-reveal="wipe"]:not([data-in="true"]) img {
    transform: scale(1.12);
  }
  [data-reveal]:not([data-in="true"]) .pby-fit-bar {
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }

  @supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
    @keyframes pby-slab {
      from {
        transform: scaleY(0);
      }
      to {
        transform: scaleY(1);
      }
    }
    .pby-case::before {
      animation: pby-slab linear both;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 0% entry 70%;
    }
  }
}

/* ---------- reduced motion: a finished static page ---------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .pby-progress,
  .pby-pulse {
    display: none;
  }
  .pby-marquee-track {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    width: auto;
  }
  .pby-marquee-set:nth-child(2) {
    display: none;
  }
  .pby-form-stage[data-status="success"] .pby-form {
    visibility: hidden;
  }
  .pby-menu {
    clip-path: none;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity 120ms linear;
  }
  .pby-menu[data-open="true"] {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
  }
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { ROLE_IDS, ROLE_LIST, type RoleId } from "../content/roles";
import { isSettled, springStep, type SpringState } from "../motion/math";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../motion/useReducedMotion";
import { useRole } from "./RoleProvider";
import { cablePath, jackCenterX, stepRole } from "./routing";

const HEIGHT = 168;
const PLUG_Y = 84;
const ORIGIN = { x: 30, y: 24 };
const BASE_SAG = 34;
const MAX_EXTRA_SAG = 60;

/**
 * The page's signature control. A cable hangs from the IN jack to a plug that
 * is driven by a damped spring; the plug overshoots and latches into the jack
 * you chose. Geometry is written straight to the DOM, never through state.
 */
export function PatchBay() {
  const { role, setRole } = useRole();
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pathRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null);
  const plugRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const buttonRefs = useRef<Partial<Record<RoleId, HTMLButtonElement | null>>>({});
  const widthRef = useRef(0);
  const springRef = useRef<SpringState>({ value: 0, velocity: 0 });
  const targetRef = useRef(0);
  const frameRef = useRef(0);
  const lastRef = useRef(0);

  const paint = useCallback(() => {
    const { value, velocity } = springRef.current;
    const sag = BASE_SAG + Math.min(MAX_EXTRA_SAG, Math.abs(velocity) * 0.05);
    pathRef.current?.setAttribute("d", cablePath(ORIGIN, { x: value, y: PLUG_Y }, sag));
    plugRef.current?.style.setProperty("--plug-x", `${value.toFixed(1)}px`);
  }, []);

  const setSeated = useCallback((seated: boolean) => {
    const plug = plugRef.current;
    if (plug) plug.dataset.seated = String(seated);
  }, []);

  const run = useCallback(() => {
    if (frameRef.current) return;
    lastRef.current = performance.now();
    setSeated(false);
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      const dt = Math.min((now - lastRef.current) / 1000, 0.05);
      lastRef.current = now;
      springRef.current = springStep(springRef.current, targetRef.current, dt);
      paint();
      if (isSettled(springRef.current, targetRef.current)) {
        springRef.current = { value: targetRef.current, velocity: 0 };
        paint();
        frameRef.current = 0;
        setSeated(true);
        return;
      }
      frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }, [paint, setSeated]);

  const retarget = useCallback(
    (snap: boolean) => {
      if (!widthRef.current) return;
      targetRef.current = jackCenterX(ROLE_IDS.indexOf(role), ROLE_IDS.length, widthRef.current);
      if (snap || reduced) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
        frameRef.current = 0;
        springRef.current = { value: targetRef.current, velocity: 0 };
        paint();
        setSeated(true);
      } else {
        run();
      }
    },
    [paint, reduced, role, run, setSeated],
  );

  // Held in a ref so the observer is created once; re-creating it on every role change would snap the plug and cancel the spring.
  const retargetRef = useRef(retarget);
  useEffect(() => {
    retargetRef.current = retarget;
  }, [retarget]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const wrap = wrapRef.current;
    if (!wrap) return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
      widthRef.current = entry.contentRect.width;
      wrap.dataset.ready = "true";
      retargetRef.current(true);
    });
    observer.observe(wrap);
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      frameRef.current = 0;
    };
  }, []);

  const mountedRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    // The first run is handled by the observer's initial snap.
    if (!mountedRef.current) {
      mountedRef.current = true;
      return;
    }
    retarget(false);
  }, [role, retarget]);

  const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const delta = event.key === "ArrowRight" || event.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -1 : 0;
    if (!delta) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const next = stepRole(role, delta);
    setRole(next);
    buttonRefs.current[next]?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <div className="pby-bay-wrap">
      <div className="pby-bay-head pby-mono">
        <span>PATCHBAY / 04 JACKS</span>
        <span className="pby-led-row" aria-hidden="true">
          <i className="pby-led" />
          SIGNAL
        </span>
      </div>
      <div ref={wrapRef} className="pby-bay" style={{ height: HEIGHT }} data-ready="false">
        <span className="pby-bay-in pby-mono" aria-hidden="true">
          IN
        </span>
        <svg className="pby-cable" width="100%" height={HEIGHT} aria-hidden="true">
          <path ref={pathRef} d={cablePath(ORIGIN, { x: ORIGIN.x, y: PLUG_Y }, BASE_SAG)} />
        </svg>
        <span ref={plugRef} className="pby-plug" data-seated="true" aria-hidden="true" />
        <div className="pby-jacks" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Choose which discipline to route the page to" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
          {ROLE_LIST.map((item) => {
            const active = item.id === role;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                ref={(node) => {
                  buttonRefs.current[item.id] = node;
                }}
                type="button"
                role="radio"
                aria-checked={active}
                tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1}
                className="pby-jack"
                data-active={active}
                onClick={() => setRole(item.id)}
              >
                <span className="pby-jack-hole" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span className="pby-jack-label">{item.label}</span>
                <span className="pby-jack-code pby-mono" aria-hidden="true">
                  {item.code}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

    <file path="src/app/(patchbay)/patchbay/bay/RoleProvider.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { DEFAULT_ROLE } from "../content/defaults";
import { ROLES, type Role, type RoleId } from "../content/roles";
import { parseRole, roleHref } from "./routing";

type RoleContextValue = { role: RoleId; data: Role; setRole: (next: RoleId) => void };

const RoleContext = createContext<RoleContextValue | null>(null);

export function useRole(): RoleContextValue {
  const value = useContext(RoleContext);
  if (!value) throw new Error("useRole must be used inside <RoleProvider>");
  return value;
}

const PULSE_MS = 900;

/**
 * Owns the selected role. The role lives in the URL (?role=ai) so a recruiter
 * can be sent straight to one view, and in <html data-role> so CSS can react.
 */
export function RoleProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [role, setRoleState] = useState<RoleId>(DEFAULT_ROLE);
  const [routeCount, setRouteCount] = useState(0);
  const roleRef = useRef<RoleId>(DEFAULT_ROLE);

  const apply = useCallback((next: RoleId, announce: boolean) => {
    if (roleRef.current === next) return;
    roleRef.current = next;
    setRoleState(next);
    if (announce) setRouteCount((count) => count + 1);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    apply(parseRole(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("role")), false);
    const onPop = () => apply(parseRole(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("role")), true);
    window.addEventListener("popstate", onPop);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", onPop);
  }, [apply]);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.role = role;
    if (routeCount > 0) document.documentElement.dataset.routed = "true";
  }, [role, routeCount]);

  const setRole = useCallback(
    (next: RoleId) => {
      if (roleRef.current === next) return;
      apply(next, true);
      const { pathname, search, hash } = window.location;
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", `${pathname}${roleHref(next, search)}${hash}`);
    },
    [apply],
  );

  const value = useMemo(() => ({ role, data: ROLES[role], setRole }), [role, setRole]);

  return (
    <RoleContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      {routeCount > 0 && <span key={routeCount} className="pby-pulse" aria-hidden="true" style={{ animationDuration: `${PULSE_MS}ms` }} />}
      <p className="pby-sr" role="status">
        {routeCount > 0 ? `Page routed to ${ROLES[role].label}` : ""}
      </p>
    </RoleContext.Provider>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(patchbay)/patchbay/bay/routing.ts">
<![CDATA[import { DEFAULT_ROLE } from "../content/defaults";
import { ROLE_IDS, type RoleId } from "../content/roles";

export function isRoleId(value: unknown): value is RoleId {
  return typeof value === "string" && (ROLE_IDS as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

/** Unknown or missing values fall back to the default so a bad link never breaks the page. */
export function parseRole(value: string | null | undefined): RoleId {
  return isRoleId(value) ? value : DEFAULT_ROLE;
}

/** Wraps around: the jack row is a loop, so ArrowRight on the last jack returns to the first. */
export function stepRole(current: RoleId, delta: number): RoleId {
  const index = ROLE_IDS.indexOf(current);
  const next = (((index + delta) % ROLE_IDS.length) + ROLE_IDS.length) % ROLE_IDS.length;
  return ROLE_IDS[next];
}

type Weighted = { weights: Record<RoleId, number> };

/** Highest weight first, ties keep authored order, zero-weight items are hidden. */
export function rankForRole<T extends Weighted>(items: readonly T[], role: RoleId): T[] {
  return items
    .map((item, order) => ({ item, order, weight: item.weights[role] }))
    .filter((entry) => entry.weight > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b.weight - a.weight || a.order - b.order)
    .map((entry) => entry.item);
}

export type Point = { x: number; y: number };

/** Cubic path that hangs under gravity: both control points sag below the endpoints. */
export function cablePath(from: Point, to: Point, sag: number): string {
  const fmt = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 10) / 10;
  return `M${fmt(from.x)} ${fmt(from.y)} C${fmt(from.x)} ${fmt(from.y + sag)} ${fmt(to.x)} ${fmt(to.y + sag)} ${fmt(to.x)} ${fmt(to.y)}`;
}

/** Centre of jack `index` when `count` equal columns span `width`. */
export function jackCenterX(index: number, count: number, width: number): number {
  return ((index + 0.5) / count) * width;
}

export function roleHref(role: RoleId, search: string): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(search);
  if (role === DEFAULT_ROLE) params.delete("role");
  else params.set("role", role);
  const query = params.toString();
  return query ? `?${query}` : "";
}

<![CDATA[export const ROLE_IDS = ["web", "fullstack", "ai", "design"] as const;
export type RoleId = (typeof ROLE_IDS)[number];

export type Metric = { value: number; suffix: string; label: string };
export type ProcessStep = { title: string; body: string };

export type Role = {
  id: RoleId;
  /** Label on the jack. */

  /** Three-letter code stamped under the jack. */

  eyebrow: string;
  headline: readonly [string, string];
  sub: string;
  cta: string;
  metrics: readonly Metric[];
  stack: { inputs: readonly string[]; core: readonly string[]; outputs: readonly string[] };
  process: readonly ProcessStep[];
  caseStudy: {
    projectId: string;
    problem: string;
    approach: readonly string[];
    result: readonly Metric[];
  };
};

/**
 * Owners edit this map to retarget the template: delete a role to remove its
 * jack, or add a role id to ROLE_IDS and give it an entry here.
 */

    <file path="src/app/(patchbay)/patchbay/forms/contact.ts">
<![CDATA[import type { RoleId } from "../content/roles";

export type ContactFields = { name: string; email: string; role: RoleId | ""; message: string };
export type ContactErrors = Partial<Record<keyof ContactFields, string>>;

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;
export const MESSAGE_MIN = 20;
export const MESSAGE_MAX = 600;

export function validateContact(fields: ContactFields): ContactErrors {
  const errors: ContactErrors = {};
  if (fields.name.trim().length < 2) errors.name = "Tell me who's writing.";
  if (!EMAIL.test(fields.email.trim())) errors.email = "That email doesn't look right.";
  if (!fields.role) errors.role = "Pick the kind of work this is about.";
  const length = fields.message.trim().length;
  if (length < MESSAGE_MIN) errors.message = `A few more words, please (${MESSAGE_MIN - length} to go).`;
  if (length > MESSAGE_MAX) errors.message = `Keep it under ${MESSAGE_MAX} characters.`;
  return errors;
}

/** Stable short reference derived from the brief itself, so the same brief always gets the same ticket. */
export function briefReference(fields: ContactFields): string {
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (const char of [fields.name, fields.email, fields.role, fields.message].join("|")) {
    hash ^= char.charCodeAt(0);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
  }
  return `PB-${(hash >>> 0).toString(36).toUpperCase().padStart(7, "0").slice(0, 6)}`;
}

/** The template has no backend, so the brief is prepared as a local file and never claimed as sent. */
export function briefAsText(fields: ContactFields, reference: string): string {
  return [`Brief ${reference}`, `From: ${fields.name.trim()} <${fields.email.trim()}>`, `Role: ${fields.role}`, "", fields.message.trim(), ""].join("\n");
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useRole } from "../bay/RoleProvider";
import { ROLE_LIST, type RoleId } from "../content/roles";
import { Magnetic } from "../motion/Magnetic";
import { briefAsText, briefReference, MESSAGE_MAX, validateContact, type ContactErrors, type ContactFields } from "./contact";

type Status = "idle" | "loading" | "success";

const FAKE_LATENCY_MS = 900;

export function ContactForm() {
  const { role } = useRole();
  const [fields, setFields] = useState<ContactFields>({ name: "", email: "", role: "", message: "" });
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<ContactErrors>({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>("idle");
  const [reference, setReference] = useState("");
  const roleTouched = useRef(false);
  const fieldRefs = useRef<Partial<Record<keyof ContactFields, HTMLElement | null>>>({});
  const timer = useRef<number>(0);

  // Until the visitor chooses, the form follows whichever jack the page is routed to.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!roleTouched.current) setFields((current) => ({ ...current, role }));
  }, [role]);

  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

  const update = <K extends keyof ContactFields>(key: K, value: ContactFields[K]) => {
    if (key === "role") roleTouched.current = true;
    setFields((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
    if (errors[key]) setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: undefined }));
  };

  const shake = (keys: (keyof ContactFields)[]) => {
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
    for (const key of keys) {
      fieldRefs.current[key]?.closest(".pby-field")?.animate(
        [{ transform: "translateX(0)" }, { transform: "translateX(-6px)" }, { transform: "translateX(6px)" }, { transform: "translateX(-3px)" }, { transform: "translateX(0)" }],
        { duration: 280, easing: "cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)" },
      );
    }
  };

  const onSubmit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (status !== "idle") return;
    const found = validateContact(fields);
    setErrors(found);
    const invalid = Object.keys(found) as (keyof ContactFields)[];
    if (invalid.length) {
      shake(invalid);
      fieldRefs.current[invalid[0]]?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setStatus("loading");
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setReference(briefReference(fields));
      setStatus("success");
    }, FAKE_LATENCY_MS);
  };

  const download = () => {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([briefAsText(fields, reference)], { type: "text/plain" }));
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `${reference}.txt`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const reset = () => {
    roleTouched.current = false;
    setFields({ name: "", email: "", role, message: "" });
    setErrors({});
    setStatus("idle");
  };

  const register = (key: keyof ContactFields) => (node: HTMLElement | null) => {
    fieldRefs.current[key] = node;
  };
  const describe = (key: keyof ContactFields) => (errors[key] ? `pby-err-${key}` : undefined);

  return (
    <div className="pby-form-stage" data-status={status}>
      <form className="pby-form" onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate inert={status === "success"} aria-busy={status === "loading"}>
        <div className="pby-field" data-invalid={Boolean(errors.name)}>
          <input ref={register("name")} id="pby-name" name="name" autoComplete="name" placeholder=" " value={fields.name} onChange={(e) => update("name", e.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.name)} aria-describedby={describe("name")} />
          <label htmlFor="pby-name">Your name</label>
          {errors.name && (
            <p id="pby-err-name" className="pby-error" role="alert">
              {errors.name}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="pby-field" data-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)}>
          <input ref={register("email")} id="pby-email" name="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder=" " value={fields.email} onChange={(e) => update("email", e.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)} aria-describedby={describe("email")} />
          <label htmlFor="pby-email">Email</label>
          {errors.email && (
            <p id="pby-err-email" className="pby-error" role="alert">
              {errors.email}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="pby-field pby-field-select" data-invalid={Boolean(errors.role)}>
          <select ref={register("role")} id="pby-role" name="role" value={fields.role} onChange={(e) => update("role", e.target.value as RoleId | "")} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.role)} aria-describedby={describe("role")}>
            <option value="" disabled>
              Chooseâ€¦
            </option>
            {ROLE_LIST.map((item) => (
              <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                {item.eyebrow}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <label htmlFor="pby-role">I need aâ€¦</label>
          {errors.role && (
            <p id="pby-err-role" className="pby-error" role="alert">
              {errors.role}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="pby-field pby-field-wide" data-invalid={Boolean(errors.message)}>
          <textarea ref={register("message")} id="pby-message" name="message" rows={5} placeholder=" " value={fields.message} onChange={(e) => update("message", e.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.message)} aria-describedby={describe("message")} />
          <label htmlFor="pby-message">What are you building?</label>
          <span className="pby-count pby-mono" aria-hidden="true">
            {fields.message.length}/{MESSAGE_MAX}
          </span>
          {errors.message && (
            <p id="pby-err-message" className="pby-error" role="alert">
              {errors.message}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <Magnetic className="pby-field-wide">
          <button type="submit" className="pby-btn pby-btn-primary pby-submit" disabled={status === "loading"}>
            <span className="pby-btn-label">
              {status === "loading" ? "Routingâ€¦" : "Prepare my brief"}
            </span>
            <span className="pby-btn-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
              {status === "loading" ? <i className="pby-spinner" /> : "â†’"}
            </span>
          </button>
        </Magnetic>
      </form>

      <div className="pby-success" inert={status !== "success"} role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {status === "success" && (
          <>
            <svg className="pby-check" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true" fill="none">
              <circle cx="24" cy="24" r="22" />
              <path d="M14 25 L21 32 L34 17" />
            </svg>
            <p className="pby-mono pby-success-ref">Ticket {reference}</p>
            <h3 className="pby-h3">Brief patched in.</h3>
            <p className="pby-lede">Nothing was sent. Download your brief and email it, or start another.</p>
            <div className="pby-cta-row">
              <button type="button" className="pby-btn pby-btn-primary" onClick={download}>
                <span className="pby-btn-label">
                  Download brief
                </span>
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="pby-btn pby-btn-ghost" onClick={reset}>
                <span className="pby-btn-label">
                  Start another
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(patchbay)/patchbay/motion/CountUp.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { easeOutCubic } from "./math";
import { useInView } from "./useInView";
import { useReducedMotion } from "./useReducedMotion";

type CountUpProps = { value: number; suffix?: string; durationMs?: number; className?: string };

function format(value: number, decimals: number): string {
  return value.toFixed(decimals);
}

/** The final value always sits in a visually hidden span; the animated one is aria-hidden. */
export function CountUp({ value, suffix = "", durationMs = 1100, className }: CountUpProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const { ref, inView } = useInView<HTMLSpanElement>();
  const displayRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const decimals = Number.isInteger(value) ? 0 : 2;

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = displayRef.current;
    if (!node) return;
    if (reduced || !inView) {
      node.textContent = format(reduced || inView ? value : 0, decimals);
      return;
    }
    let frame = 0;
    const start = performance.now();
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / durationMs);
      node.textContent = format(value * easeOutCubic(t), decimals);
      if (t < 1) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [decimals, durationMs, inView, reduced, value]);

  return (
    <span ref={ref} className={className}>
      <span className="pby-sr">
        {format(value, decimals)}
        {suffix}
      </span>
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="pby-tabular">
        <span ref={displayRef}>{format(value, decimals)}</span>
        {suffix}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(patchbay)/patchbay/motion/Magnetic.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { lerp } from "./math";

const MAX_PULL = 12;

/** Pointer-proximity pull on fine pointers only; the label follows at 40% so the button feels weighty. */
export function Magnetic({ children, className }: { children: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node || !window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches || window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
    let frame = 0;
    let x = 0;
    let y = 0;
    let targetX = 0;
    let targetY = 0;

    const tick = () => {
      x = lerp(x, targetX, 0.18);
      y = lerp(y, targetY, 0.18);
      node.style.setProperty("--mag-x", `${x.toFixed(2)}px`);
      node.style.setProperty("--mag-y", `${y.toFixed(2)}px`);
      frame = Math.abs(x - targetX) + Math.abs(y - targetY) > 0.05 ? requestAnimationFrame(tick) : 0;
    };
    const kick = () => {
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    const move = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dx = event.clientX - (rect.left + rect.width / 2);
      const dy = event.clientY - (rect.top + rect.height / 2);
      targetX = Math.max(-MAX_PULL, Math.min(MAX_PULL, dx * 0.25));
      targetY = Math.max(-MAX_PULL, Math.min(MAX_PULL, dy * 0.25));
      kick();
    };
    const leave = () => {
      targetX = 0;
      targetY = 0;
      kick();
    };

    node.addEventListener("pointermove", move, { passive: true });
    node.addEventListener("pointerleave", leave);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      node.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
      node.removeEventListener("pointerleave", leave);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <span ref={ref} className={`pby-magnetic ${className ?? ""}`}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

    <file path="src/app/(patchbay)/patchbay/motion/math.ts">
<![CDATA[export const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number): number => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

export const lerp = (from: number, to: number, t: number): number => from + (to - from) * t;

/** Normalised 0–1 position of `value` between `start` and `end`; a zero-width range resolves to 0. */
export function progress(value: number, start: number, end: number): number {
  if (end === start) return 0;
  return clamp((value - start) / (end - start), 0, 1);
}

/** Delay for the nth child of a cascade, capped so long lists never feel slow. */
export function staggerDelay(index: number, stepMs: number, capMs = 600): number {
  return Math.min(Math.max(index, 0) * stepMs, capMs);
}

export function easeOutCubic(t: number): number {
  const x = clamp(t, 0, 1);
  return 1 - (1 - x) ** 3;
}

export type SpringState = { value: number; velocity: number };

/**
 * One semi-implicit Euler step of a damped spring. Sub-steps keep it stable
 * when a tab was throttled and `dtSeconds` is large.
 */
export function springStep(state: SpringState, target: number, dtSeconds: number, stiffness = 220, damping = 17): SpringState {
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dtSeconds / (1 / 120)));
  const h = Math.min(dtSeconds, 0.1) / steps;
  let { value, velocity } = state;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i += 1) {
    velocity += (-stiffness * (value - target) - damping * velocity) * h;
    value += velocity * h;
  }
  return { value, velocity };
}

export function isSettled(state: SpringState, target: number, epsilon = 0.05): boolean {
  return Math.abs(state.value - target) < epsilon && Math.abs(state.velocity) < epsilon;
}
]]>

type RevealProps = {

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { progress } from "./math";
import { useReducedMotion } from "./useReducedMotion";

/**
 * Writes --progress (page) and --hero-p (first viewport) on <html> from one
 * rAF-throttled listener, so scroll never touches React state.
 */
export function ScrollProgress() {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    if (reduced) {
      root.style.setProperty("--progress", "0");
      root.style.setProperty("--hero-p", "0");
      return;
    }
    let frame = 0;
    let viewport = window.innerHeight;
    let maxScroll = Math.max(1, root.scrollHeight - viewport);

    const measure = () => {
      viewport = window.innerHeight;
      maxScroll = Math.max(1, root.scrollHeight - viewport);
    };
    const write = () => {
      frame = 0;
      const y = window.scrollY;
      root.style.setProperty("--progress", progress(y, 0, maxScroll).toFixed(4));
      root.style.setProperty("--hero-p", progress(y, 0, viewport * 0.9).toFixed(4));
    };
    const schedule = () => {
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(write);
    };

    write();
    const resize = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      measure();
      schedule();
    });
    resize.observe(document.body);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", schedule, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      resize.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
    };
  }, [reduced]);

  return <div className="pby-progress" aria-hidden="true" />;
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(patchbay)/patchbay/motion/SmoothScroll.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useReducedMotion } from "./useReducedMotion";

/** Lenis is imported lazily and skipped on touch screens (native momentum is better) and under reduced motion. */
export function SmoothScroll() {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced || window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    let frame = 0;
    let destroy = () => {};

    void import("lenis").then(({ default: Lenis }) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      const lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1 });
      const raf = (time: number) => {
        lenis.raf(time);
        frame = requestAnimationFrame(raf);
      };
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(raf);
      const onAnchor = (event: MouseEvent) => {
        const link = (event.target as Element).closest<HTMLAnchorElement>('a[href^="#"]');
        const id = link?.getAttribute("href")?.slice(1);
        const target = id ? document.getElementById(id) : null;
        if (!target) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: -72 });
      };
      document.addEventListener("click", onAnchor);
      destroy = () => {
        document.removeEventListener("click", onAnchor);
        lenis.destroy();
      };
    });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      destroy();
    };
  }, [reduced]);

  return null;
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";

const MAX_TILT_DEG = 5;

/** Writes --mx/--my (spotlight) and --rx/--ry (tilt) from one rAF; fine pointers only. */
export function TiltCard({ children, className }: { children: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node || !window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches || window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
    let frame = 0;
    let event: PointerEvent | null = null;

    const write = () => {
      frame = 0;
      if (!event) return;
      const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      const px = (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
      const py = (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
      node.style.setProperty("--mx", `${(px * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);
      node.style.setProperty("--my", `${(py * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);
      node.style.setProperty("--rx", `${((0.5 - py) * 2 * MAX_TILT_DEG).toFixed(2)}deg`);
      node.style.setProperty("--ry", `${((px - 0.5) * 2 * MAX_TILT_DEG).toFixed(2)}deg`);
    };
    const move = (next: PointerEvent) => {
      event = next;
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(write);
    };
    const leave = () => {
      event = null;
      node.style.setProperty("--rx", "0deg");
      node.style.setProperty("--ry", "0deg");
    };

    node.addEventListener("pointermove", move, { passive: true });
    node.addEventListener("pointerleave", leave);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      node.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
      node.removeEventListener("pointerleave", leave);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <article ref={ref} className={`pby-tilt ${className ?? ""}`}>
      {children}
    </article>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(patchbay)/patchbay/motion/useInView.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

type Listener = (entry: IntersectionObserverEntry) => void;

const listeners = new Map<Element, Listener>();
let observer: IntersectionObserver | null = null;

/** One observer for the whole template; each element registers a listener. */
function getObserver(rootMargin: string): IntersectionObserver {
  if (!observer) {
    observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) listeners.get(entry.target)?.(entry);
      },
      { rootMargin },
    );
  }
  return observer;
}

type Options = { once?: boolean; rootMargin?: string };

export function useInView<T extends Element>({ once = true, rootMargin = "0px 0px -12% 0px" }: Options = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node) return;
    const io = getObserver(rootMargin);
    listeners.set(node, (entry) => {
      setInView(entry.isIntersecting);
      if (entry.isIntersecting && once) {
        io.unobserve(node);
        listeners.delete(node);
      }
    });
    io.observe(node);
    return () => {
      io.unobserve(node);
      listeners.delete(node);
    };
  }, [once, rootMargin]);

  return { ref, inView };
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(patchbay)/patchbay/motion/useReducedMotion.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

const QUERY = "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)";

function subscribe(onChange: () => void): () => void {
  const media = window.matchMedia(QUERY);
  media.addEventListener("change", onChange);
  return () => media.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
}

/** The server snapshot is `true` so the first paint is the finished, motion-free layout. */
export function useReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribe,
    () => window.matchMedia(QUERY).matches,
    () => true,
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { Logo } from "../brand/Logo";
import { RoleChips } from "../bay/RoleChips";
import { PROFILE } from "../content/profile";

export const NAV_LINKS = [
  { id: "work", label: "Work" },
  { id: "stack", label: "Stack" },
  { id: "process", label: "Process" },
  { id: "case", label: "Case study" },
  { id: "about", label: "About" },
  { id: "contact", label: "Contact" },
] as const;

const COMPACT_AFTER_PX = 80;

export function Header() {
  const [compact, setCompact] = useState(false);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = useState<string>("");
  const navRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const toggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const linkRefs = useRef<Record<string, HTMLAnchorElement | null>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    let frame = 0;
    const update = () => {
      frame = 0;
      setCompact(window.scrollY > COMPACT_AFTER_PX);
    };
    const onScroll = () => {
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(update);
    };
    update();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) if (entry.isIntersecting) setActive(entry.target.id);
      },
      { rootMargin: "-40% 0px -55% 0px" },
    );
    for (const { id } of NAV_LINKS) {
      const section = document.getElementById(id);
      if (section) observer.observe(section);
    }
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const placeIndicator = useCallback(() => {
    const nav = navRef.current;
    const link = linkRefs.current[active];
    if (!nav) return;
    if (!link) {
      nav.style.setProperty("--ind-o", "0");
      return;
    }
    nav.style.setProperty("--ind-x", `${link.offsetLeft}px`);
    nav.style.setProperty("--ind-w", String(link.offsetWidth));
    nav.style.setProperty("--ind-o", "1");
  }, [active]);

  useEffect(() => {
    placeIndicator();
    window.addEventListener("resize", placeIndicator, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", placeIndicator);
  }, [placeIndicator]);

  const close = useCallback(() => {
    setOpen(false);
    toggleRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const previous = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    menuRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("a, button")?.focus();
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = previous;
    };
  }, [open]);

  const onMenuKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (event.key === "Escape") {
      close();
      return;
    }
    if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
    const focusable = [...(menuRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("a, button") ?? []), ...(toggleRef.current ? [toggleRef.current] : [])];
    const first = focusable[0];
    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
    if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
      event.preventDefault();
      last.focus();
    } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
      event.preventDefault();
      first.focus();
    }
  };

  return (
    <header className="pby-header" data-state={compact ? "compact" : "top"} data-menu={open ? "open" : "closed"} onKeyDown={open ? onMenuKeyDown : undefined}>
      <div className="pby-header-inner">
        <a href="#top" className="pby-header-logo pby-load" style={{ "--d": "150ms" } as React.CSSProperties} aria-label={`${PROFILE.name}, back to top`}>
          <Logo name={PROFILE.name} />
        </a>
        <nav ref={navRef} className="pby-nav" aria-label="Sections">
          <span className="pby-nav-indicator" aria-hidden="true" />
          {NAV_LINKS.map((link, index) => (
            <a
              key={link.id}
              ref={(node) => {
                linkRefs.current[link.id] = node;
              }}
              href={`#${link.id}`}
              className="pby-nav-link pby-load"
              style={{ "--d": `${220 + index * 50}ms` } as React.CSSProperties}
              aria-current={active === link.id ? "true" : undefined}
            >
              {link.label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </nav>
        <RoleChips className="pby-chips-header" />
        <button ref={toggleRef} type="button" className="pby-menu-toggle" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls="pby-menu" aria-label={open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"} onClick={() => (open ? close() : setOpen(true))}>
          <span className="pby-menu-bars" aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div id="pby-menu" ref={menuRef} className="pby-menu" data-open={open} inert={!open}>
        <nav aria-label="Sections (menu)">
          {NAV_LINKS.map((link, index) => (
            <a key={link.id} href={`#${link.id}`} className="pby-menu-link" style={{ "--i": index } as React.CSSProperties} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              <span className="pby-mono">{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
              {link.label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </nav>
        <RoleChips className="pby-chips-menu" />
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";

const MAX_WEIGHT = 10;

export function Work() {

  return (
    <section id="work" className="pby-section pby-shell" aria-labelledby="pby-work-title">

      </Reveal>
      <div key={role} className="pby-cards">
        {projects.map((project, index) => (
          <Reveal key={project.id} variant="scale" index={index} className="pby-card-slot">
            <TiltCard className="pby-card">
              <Picture assetKey={`project-${project.id}`} alt={`${project.title}: ${project.kind}`} className="pby-card-media" sizes="(min-width: 900px) 33vw, 100vw" />
              <div className="pby-card-body">
                <p className="pby-card-meta pby-mono">
                  <span>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
                  <span>{project.year}</span>

                <p className="pby-card-kind">{project.kind}</p>

                  {project.tags.map((tag) => (
                    <li key={tag} className="pby-tag pby-mono">
                      {tag}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
                <p className="pby-card-proof">{project.proof}</p>
                <div className="pby-fit" role="img" aria-label={`Fit for ${data.label}: ${project.weights[role]} out of ${MAX_WEIGHT}`}>
                  <span className="pby-fit-bar" style={{ "--fit": project.weights[role] / MAX_WEIGHT } as CSSProperties} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </TiltCard>
          </Reveal>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
